text_en: From the wilderness of Sin the whole congregation of the Israelites journeyed by stages, as the Lord commanded. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.
text_cn: 以色列子民全会众按照上主的吩咐，由欣旷野起程，一站一站地前行，然后在勒非丁安了营。在那里百姓没有水喝，

text_en: The people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink. ” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test the Lord ? ”
text_cn: 因此百姓与梅瑟争吵说：“给我们水喝吧！”梅瑟回答他们说：“你们为什么与我争吵，为什么试探上主？”

text_en: But the people thirsted there for water; and the people complained against Moses and said, “Why did you bring us out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and livestock with thirst? ”
text_cn: 因百姓在那里渴望水喝，就抱怨梅瑟说：“你为什么从埃及领我们上来？难道要使我们，我们的子女和牲畜都渴死吗？”

text_en: So Moses cried out to the Lord , “What shall I do with this people? They are almost ready to stone me. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟向上主呼号说：“我要怎样对待这百姓呢？他们几乎愿用石头砸死我！”

text_en: The Lord said to Moses, “Go on ahead of the people, and take some of the elders of Israel with you; take in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.
text_cn: 上主回答梅瑟说：“你到百姓面前去，带上几个以色列长老，手中拿着你击打尼罗河的棍杖去！

text_en: I will be standing there in front of you on the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out of it, so that the people may drink. ” Moses did so, in the sight of the elders of Israel.
text_cn: 看，我要在你面前站在曷勒布那里的磐石上， 你击打磐石，就有水流出来，给百姓喝。”梅瑟就在以色列的长老眼前照样作了。

text_en: He called the place Massah and Meribah, because the Israelites quarreled and tested the Lord , saying, “Is the Lord among us or not? ”
text_cn: 他称那地方为玛撒和默黎巴，因为以色列子民在那里争吵过，并试探过上主说：“上主是否在我们中间？”

text_en: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel at Rephidim.
text_cn: 那时有阿玛肋克人，来在勒非丁同以色列人作战。

text_en: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose some men for us and go out, fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the staff of God in my hand. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟向若苏厄说：“你给我们选拔壮丁，明天去同阿玛肋克作战，我手中拿着天主的棍杖，站在这高岗顶上。”

text_en: So Joshua did as Moses told him, and fought with Amalek, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
text_cn: 若苏厄就照梅瑟吩咐他的作了，去同阿玛肋克作战；同时梅瑟、亚郎和胡尔上了那高岗顶上。

text_en: Whenever Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed; and whenever he lowered his hand, Amalek prevailed.
text_cn: 当梅瑟举手的时候，以色列就打胜仗；放下手的时候，阿玛肋克就打胜仗。

text_en: But Moses’ hands grew weary; so they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on one side, and the other on the other side; so his hands were steady until the sun set.
text_cn: 终于梅瑟的手举疲乏了。他们就搬了块石头来，放在他下边，叫他坐下，亚郎和胡尔，一边一个托着他的手：这样他的手举着不动，直到日落的时候。

text_en: And Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the sword.
text_cn: 于是若苏厄用刀剑打败了阿玛肋克和他的人民。

text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Write this as a reminder in a book and recite it in the hearing of Joshua: I will utterly blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven. ”
text_cn: 上主向梅瑟说：“将这事写在书上作为记念，并训示若苏厄，我要从天下把阿玛肋克的记念完全消灭。”

text_en: And Moses built an altar and called it, The Lord is my banner.
text_cn: 梅瑟筑了一座祭坛，给它起名叫"雅威尼息"，

text_en: He said, “A hand upon the banner of the Lord ! The Lord will have war with Amalek from generation to generation. ”
text_cn: 说：“向上主的旌(jīng)旗举手，上主必世世代代与阿玛肋克作战。”
